events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has shown the military strength of the US, but also its waning geopolitical power. The conflict has led to a rise in tensions in the Middle East, with potential implications for global oil prices and trade.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares Dow Jones US Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war could lead to higher oil prices, which would negatively impact the US economy and potentially lead to a decline in the stock market. However, the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) could be a safe haven for investors seeking diversification.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and US-Iran tensions

events.exitStrategy: Exit if oil prices drop below $50/bbl
